name: Narukawa Hime
source:
Hime is a cheerful girl from the protagonist’s class. She’s pretty popular and gets on well with everybody. She works part-time in the beachside restaraunt called "Jellyfish". Her hobbies include listening to music and playing games.

As a child, she often played outside with boys. Consequently, Hime developed a competitive personality and due to this, everyone considers her a tomboy. Currently, she’s trying to act more ladylike. Hime is very friendly and gets along with just about anyone.

[From [url=https://liemyx.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/lovelyxcation-2-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url]] & [From [url=http://amaenboda.wordpress.com/2013/06/03/three-way-review-lovely-x-cation-2/comment-page-1/]Amaenbou Dane~[/url]]
